annotations.title: Many maisters,.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> He meaneth principally Sect-maisters that make them selues seueral Ringleaders in sundry sortes of new deuised doctrines: euery one arrogating to him self to be maister, and none so humble as to be a scholer, either to Gods Church and true Pastors, or to other guides and authors of the said sectes. So did Zuinglius disdaine to be Luthers scholer, and Caluin to be the folower of Zuinglius.

notes.text: Many maisters are many proud Sect-maisters.
